cause_quote: The new loop `while (contextEnd > 0 && pending.length > 0)` let each poll scan back to byte zero when no PEM delimiter resolved the pending context.
user_saw: Leaving the Control UI Logs page open made the Gateway increasingly sluggish as the daily log grew.
summary: The fix caches PEM redaction state at the last complete log cursor and restores the default-pattern prefilter for per-record redaction.
reasoning: I checked the parent of #146850 and confirmed that incremental log reads were bounded by the byte window. The diff added the backward scan to the existing tail reader, and the commit recorded a roughly 53-fold slowdown on repeated polls with no decisive PEM marker. The fix also addresses a separate per-record slowdown from #170023, whose pattern-array copy bypassed the transport prefilter.
